item.text:
Here’s the practical comparison:

| Feature | iPhone 15 Pro Max | iPhone 14 Pro Max | iPhone 13 Pro Max |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Introduced | 2023 | 2022 | 2021 |
| Chip | A17 Pro | A16 Bionic | A15 Bionic |
| Body | Titanium | Stainless steel | Stainless steel |
| Weight | 221 g | 240 g | 238 g |
| Display | 6.7", 120Hz, Dynamic Island, Always-On | 6.7", 120Hz, Dynamic Island, Always-On | 6.7", 120Hz, notch, no Always-On |
| Main camera | 48MP | 48MP | 12MP |
| Telephoto | 5x optical | 3x optical | 3x optical |
| Max digital zoom | 25x | 15x | 15x |
| Video extras | Log, external ProRes 4K/60, spatial video | Action Mode, ProRes | ProRes, no Action Mode |
| Connector | USB-C, USB 3 up to 10Gb/s | Lightning | Lightning |
| Button | Action Button | Ring/Silent switch | Ring/Silent switch |
| Wireless | Wi-Fi 6E, 2nd-gen UWB, Thread | Wi-Fi 6, 1st-gen UWB | Wi-Fi 6, 1st-gen UWB |
| Battery video playback | Up to 29 hrs | Up to 29 hrs | Up to 28 hrs |
| Apple Intelligence | Supported | Not supported | Not supported |

**Bottom line:**  
The **iPhone 15 Pro Max** is the meaningful upgrade: lighter titanium body, USB-C, faster A17 Pro chip, 5x telephoto camera, better pro video features, Action Button, Wi-Fi 6E, and Apple Intelligence support.

The **iPhone 14 Pro Max** is still close in everyday use: same size, same Always-On/Dynamic Island display, same 29-hour video rating, and the big jump to a 48MP main camera over the 13 Pro Max.

The **iPhone 13 Pro Max** remains strong for battery and 120Hz display, but it feels two generations behind in camera resolution, brightness, Dynamic Island/Always-On, satellite safety features, and USB-C.

Sources: Apple technical specs for [iPhone 15 Pro Max](https://support.apple.com/en-us/111828), [iPhone 14 Pro Max](https://support.apple.com/en-la/111846), and [iPhone 13 Pro Max](https://support.apple.com/es-us/111870).
